posts.author: squiz
posts.title: Competent Admins? ..Not!
posts.html:
Hi All,
So i was just on the RP Server, playing... as a cop, playing guard for the Mayor, as a funny admin came by and shot at us.. okay so far.
But what if the Admin suddenly would be able to flyyyyy like a bird o_O, and fly away from cops. Well i thought this is serious roleplay..
And on a server which is as serious as VM there should be serious admins, as a role model for other players. But if admins start RDMing and then getting away with "Admin Power", no wonder its getting more and more a RDM Paradise.
So back to topic.. I reported "admin abuse". Elkinda said like 5min before, "report admin abuse to me...blablabla". So i did this but ehm what happend?
Nothing. I told him a 2nd time "Hello? K. was admin abusing wtf?!". So ehm... it just came back sth. like "Helloooooo?!1 go fuck yourself i am not interested in admin abusing because your a little faaaag i dont mind if my best admin friend is an important ***"
What i got when i wrote my opinion in OOC, that admins here are incompetent ****, what they definitly ARE! was a ban for 24h.
Seriously, i get a Ban, for 1st reporting that an admin was abusing  [image not archived: Shocked] and then telling my opinion about the admins, which in this case is the truth.

Think about this VM Leaders or whoever.

squiz
